scripts.//db:generate: It builds first because a Plugin's drizzle.config.ts imports defineKobaiDrizzleConfig from @kobai/core/migrations, and that specifier resolves through the package's `exports` to dist — the same path a Plugin author outside this repository takes. Recursive because every package that owns tables generates its own migrations from its own schema, Core included.
scripts.//db:push: There is deliberately no db:push script. This is the file kobai's commands live in, so it is the file where someone would reach for the convenient one. `drizzle-kit push` diffs against the LIVE database: run against a database holding Plugin tables it reports success and silently drops them, leaving their tracking rows so the migration runner believes the work is done and cannot repair it. Generate a migration instead. Observed on branch prototype/drizzle-multi-migration, FINDINGS.md section E; see docs/adr/0030-generate-and-migrate-only-never-drizzle-kit-push.md. tests/no-push-script.test.ts fails the build if a push script appears here.
scripts.test: docker compose up -d --wait db && pnpm -r build && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.ci: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && docker compose up -d --wait db && pnpm exec biome ci . && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r build && pnpm exec vitest run
